fact: On 11 June 2024 the President of the Implementation Team of Cabo Verde's National Civil Identification and Authentication System told an ECOWAS delegation in Praia that the country already has a functioning national identification card system.
title: ECOWAS Conducts Advocacy on the Deployment of The ECOWAS National Biometric Identity Card in Cabo Verde
publisher: Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS)
